SUMMARY.md: Read API for the CoworkingView catalogue plus the lead write path. Within a major version this contract is APPEND-ONLY: fields are added, never removed or retyped, because clients include mobile builds that cannot be recalled. Exception recorded 21 Oct 2026: `meta.citation.license` and `meta.citation.licenseUrl` were removed. Exception recorded 21 Oct 2026: property cards, property detail, map rows and ranked[] do not carry a third-party score, a third-party review count, or an external-ratings object. Google Maps Platform terms forbid caching those Places figures and serving them here. A legacy rating order is deprecated: it is still accepted and ordered as the default, and it is omitted from this document. A breaking change means /v2, with /v1 kept alive for at least two app releases. No API key: every endpoint is public, which the root `security: []` states explicitly. Catalogue content (descriptions, images, logos, names and prices) belongs to the respective operators and rights holders. No licence to reuse it is granted. You may link to listing pages. Systematic extraction or re-use of the catalogue database is not permitted. Catalogue responses carry that statement on `meta.catalogueNotice`, separate from `meta.citation` (source, canonical page and a one-line credit). Market rates do not carry it. The two POST /v1/leads/* operations are NOT reads: each one creates a real enquiry that is sent to the CoworkingView team and forwarded to space operators. Adjusted on 2026-10-23 after live checks: locale is required (en|de|es); examples use real slugs; removed POST /v1/leads/contact; removed POST /v1/leads/inquiry; removed /v1/rankings (410 Gone).
When the underlying CMS record was last updated. Use as a price-freshness signal; absent for rows with no tracked update time.
